fit.description:
Renderer 17, in the shell: a navigation row kept to one line in the room its parent box gives it (the
parent's width, so give the row a parent whose width does not follow it). The renderer measures every
child of the row, a repeat's items one by one; the destinations (children pressing home, library or live)
that do not fit beside the others leave from the row's end, last first, and Home always stays. Then
`nav.more` holds (draw a More control in the row on it: it is measured as if shown), `dest.more` holds for
each library left out, `nav.liveMore` for Live TV, and `nav.moreOn` while the current section is one of them.

pager.description:
A row's pager (inside a home row): this box scrolls sideways; `pageNext`/`pagePrev {row.id}` move it by
max(200, width - 2 x inset - peek) px, and `pager.*` say whether it overflows and is at an end.

press.description: Pressing it: `press` with an optional Template argument (`toggle` and `open`/`close` take a flag name).

readingStop.description:
Renderer 18: on TV this box, which presses nothing, still takes focus (wearing the focus ring) so the
remote reaches it and a screen reader reads it as one passage, by its `label` or else its text: a menu's
About line below its last control. Elsewhere it is an ordinary box (its text selectable on the web).

Condition.description: One test on the binding vocabulary or the skin's own flags; a node's `when` list must all hold.

is.description:
set: non-empty / true / non-zero (default). eq/ne: equals `value`. gt/lt: numeric. mod: `value` "n:r", the number % n == r.
Renderer 20: starts/ends: the text begins or ends with `value` (a row id's ":top").

A skin's overrides of one experience (`SkinDocument.experiences.<id>`), merged over the built-in
documents at resolve time; whatever is left out stays Vela's.

templates.description:
Templates by name, merged over every page's own. A template named after a rich-block part
(`trackTable.row`, `queue.row`) replaces that part's template, where the block allows it.

actionBar.doc: A page's action bar: play and pause (lit while playing from this source), shuffle, the heart, Follow, the title's menu, a playlist's Edit details.

buttons.doc: A comma list of play, shuffle, heart, follow, more, edit, in order.

item.doc: The title the heart, Follow and the menu act on.

sourceId.doc: Where they play from; the item when empty.

actionBar.tv: One focus row; play takes focus first when the page opens.

albumsGrid.doc: The albums grid (a Show all of albums), paged as the viewer nears its end.

artistHero.doc: An artist page's image band: the eyebrow, the name sized by its length, the releases and genres.

artistLiked.doc: "You've liked N songs" by the artist, opening Liked Songs; nothing when none.

bar.doc: The persistent now-playing bar: what is playing (cover, title, artist or chapter, the heart), the transport and the seek bar, and lyrics, Sound, the queue, volume and full screen. Spoken word trades shuffle, previous, next and repeat for speed, 15/30 s skips and the sleep timer.

queueFlag.doc: The document state flag the queue button toggles (the shell shows the queue block while it is set).

soundFlag.doc: The document state flag the Sound button toggles; opening one closes the other.

bar.tv: Not drawn on TV (the TV shell floats the mini player). Reads the audio position once a second.

bookCover.doc: A book’s cover with a spine and the page edges.

item.doc: The book or series as an item: record or a vela.title value.

bookFacts.doc: The metadata labels and values for a book.

item.doc: The book or series as an item: record or a vela.title value.

bookHero.doc: A book’s cover, series, title, author, format facts, reading progress and action.

item.doc: The book or series as an item: record or a vela.title value.

bookHero.tv: Focusable series and author links. The reading action becomes a quiet line on TV.

bookReadAction.doc: The Read, Continue reading or Read again button; a quiet explanation on TV.

item.doc: The book or series as an item: record or a vela.title value.

bookSeriesList.doc: The other books in a book’s series, or the ordered books on the series’ page.

item.doc: The book or series as an item: record or a vela.title value.

items.doc: The children as item: records, from vela.children.

bookSeriesList.tv: Each book is one focus target.

bookSummary.doc: A book or series synopsis in serif type.

item.doc: The book or series as an item: record or a vela.title value.

byline.doc: A title's byline: the artist (opening their page) and facts after it.

facts.doc: Facts after the artist: a list, or text with | between them.

collectionHeader.doc: A collection page's header: the cover, the eyebrow, the display title sized by its length, and a byline under it; stacked and centred on a phone.

eyebrow.doc: The line above the title (Album, Playlist).

collectionHeader.tv: No focus of its own; links in the byline template are focusable.

continueListening.doc: Continue listening: a card per title under way with its progress and what is left; Play resumes (select resumes on TV).

title.doc: The heading; the row's name, else "Continue listening".

cover.doc: A cover: a title's artwork (square, round for artists, book), Liked Songs' heart, a playlist's mosaic, or Rewind's, import's or duplicates' covers.

byline.doc: Letter the byline on the drawn cover too (spoken word's pages).

item.doc: The title (an item: record or a vela.title value).

poster.doc: mosaic: the playlist's own artwork, drawn instead when present.

size.doc: px; 0 is the page cover's size for the window.

tracks.doc: mosaic: the tracks whose album covers fill it.

discography.doc: An artist's discography: the heading with Albums / Singles and EPs chips, a shelf with Show all, the grid it opens, and a loading line while pages arrive.
discography.tv: The chips are a focus row; the grid moves by D-pad.

duplicates.doc: Duplicate recordings in a library and the preferred version of each (section-B duplicates block).

libraryId.doc: The library; the experience's when absent.

eq.doc: Sound: AutoMix, volume levelling and the equalizer, or only the equalizer bands (`bands`).

bands.doc: Only the equalizer bands and presets.

closeFlag.doc: The document state flag the close button clears; draws its own header with it.

eq.tv: Sliders become − and + (a remote's arrows move the focus).

genres.doc: The library's genres as coloured tiles.

homeShelves.doc: Music Home's shelves: Recently played, Jump back in, and the library's rows (rows laid out as tracks draw as track lists).

importSubtitle.doc: The import page's line under its title: the import's description, else what can be imported from (the advertised sources).

listenSearch.doc: The audio app's search page, whole (field, recent searches, results by kind).

lyrics.doc: Lyrics that follow playback: the line being sung is lit (word by word when the lyrics are word-timed), sung lines fade, the list keeps the line in view, and pressing a line seeks there. Plain lyrics scroll as text.

item.doc: The track (an item: record); the one playing when absent.

translate.doc: Show the translation under each line when the lyrics carry one.

lyrics.tv: Lines are reading stops; the active line scrolls into view without motion when motion is reduced. Word timing redraws only the active line.

musicShelf.doc: A shelf of music tiles (cover, title, a line under it) with previous and next arrows on pointers.

exclude.doc: A title id left out (an album's More by leaves the album out).

items.doc: The titles: a list source or a list of item: records.

limit.doc: At most this many tiles; 0 is all.

role.doc: Keep only titles of this role (artist, album).

musicShelf.tv: One focus row that remembers its position.

nowPlaying.doc: Now Playing: the artwork stage with its ambient tint, the title and byline, the scrubber and transport, and the queue, chapters, lyrics and Sound beside the stage (side by side by width, as the Duo window layout) or under it.

closeFlag.doc: The document state flag the close button clears; no close button without it.

visualizer.doc: Offer the visualizer (the header button and the Sound panel's switch) where env.canVisualize.

visualizerFlag.doc: The document state flag the header's visualizer button sets (the page then shows a full-screen visualizer block); no button without it.

nowPlaying.tv: The transport row and the list beside it are focus guides; the play button takes focus first. A background template is drawn behind the stage and takes no focus.

photoViewer.doc: A photo contained at its original aspect ratio, with its name, taken date and available facts.

item.doc: The photo as an item: record or a vela.title value.

photoViewer.tv: The title frame owns focus and closing.

player.doc: The mini player (a Listen player; with `channel` the node is instead the muted live preview): what plays, previous, play and pause, next (spoken word: 15 and 30 s skips), stop, and its bottom edge as the scrubber. Pressing it opens Now Playing.

openFlag.doc: The document state flag set when it is pressed (the shell shows the nowPlaying block while it is set); the app's Now Playing opens without it.

player.tv: The open button is the focus target; the transport buttons follow it in the row.

playlistImport.doc: The playlist import flow over the local import: record (section-B import block).

libraryId.doc: The library; the experience's when absent.

nameState.doc: A document state value holding the playlist name as edited, for the page's heading.

queue.doc: The queue: what is playing, what the viewer queued (Play next, Add to queue) and what comes next from the source and autoplay. Rows play, remove and move (drag on web pointers, Move up / Move down in their menu).

closeFlag.doc: The document state flag the close button clears; no close button without it.

limit.doc: Rows drawn per section, at most 200.

queue.tv: Each row is one focus target. Redraws when the queue changes, not with the position.

quickTiles.doc: Music Home's quick tiles: what was played from most recently (Liked Songs and Rewind among it), then the playlists.

rail.doc: Your Library: Home, Search and Rewind, the library heading with collapse, new playlist and the library tools, filters, and the playlists, liked albums and artists (spoken word: the books or shows under way). Collapsed it is an icon rail; embedded (a phone, a TV) a plain list.

collapseFlag.doc: The document state flag holding the viewer's collapse (the shell sizes the rail from it).

mode.doc: auto collapses below 1180 px and keeps the viewer's choice; embedded is Your Library as a page (a phone, a TV); icons is a TV's icon rail; chips is a phone's Home, Search, Your Library and Rewind chips.

rail.tv: Rows are single focus targets; the rail is one focus column.

reader.doc: The full-screen book reader, driven by Vela’s reader session.

item.doc: The book or series as an item: record or a vela.title value.

reader.tv: The reader is offered on phones, tablets, web and desktop.

recap.doc: Rewind: the listening recap for a period with its charts (section-B recap block).

libraryId.doc: The library; the experience's when absent.

periodParam.doc: A page param holding the period: the block reads it and changes it with setParam, so a vela.recap source reading {param.<name>} follows.

periodState.doc: A document state value holding the chosen period (`open name=value`), so the page's heading can read it.

recentSearches.doc: This library's recent searches (or the intro) while the field is empty; nothing once something is typed.

searchField.doc: The audio app's search field: focused as the page opens, Escape clears it, Vela's or the system's keyboard on a TV. Its query is the store's, shared with recentSearches and searchResults.
searchField.tv: One focus target that opens the keyboard; the clear button beside it.

searchResults.doc: The results for what is typed, grouped by what the library holds (top result, songs, albums, artists, people, playlists), with loading, failed and empty states; nothing while the field is empty.

seriesHero.doc: A fan of series covers, title, author, and the link to start or resume the series.

item.doc: The book or series as an item: record or a vela.title value.

items.doc: The children as item: records, from vela.children.

seriesHero.tv: A reading action becomes a quiet line on TV. Playable audio and video links remain focusable.

spokenAbout.doc: About: the summary and the facts table (a show's summary is in spokenItems).

spokenCollectionShelf.doc: A collection whose items do not all play: them as a shelf of tiles (else nothing).

spokenCredits.doc: A spoken title's credits: by the author, narrated by, hosted by.

spokenFacts.doc: The facts under the credits: year, length, parts or chapters and genre (a book); episodes and genre (a show); year and count (a collection).

spokenHome.doc: Home for the library (music Home, or spoken word's Home for audiobooks and podcasts), whole.

spokenItems.doc: A spoken title's list: a book's parts or chapters; a show's summary and episodes with the All / New chips; a collection's items when they all play.

spokenPlay.doc: A spoken title's action bar: listen or resume (and Start over), or play the show's next episode, the heart and the menu, with a line when this device cannot play it.
spokenPlay.tv: One focus row; play takes focus first.

spokenProgress.doc: An audiobook under way: the bar, what is left and the chapter; Finished once played.

spokenTitle.doc: A title page in the audio app (an album or artist for music; a book, show or collection for spoken word), whole.

tileGrid.doc: A wrapping grid of music tiles over a list source, reading its next page (vela.more) as the end comes into reach, with "Loading more…" and a retry at its end.

failed.doc: The source's error, when its last read failed ({src.x.$error}).

pending.doc: Whether a page is being read ({src.x.$pending}).

source.doc: The list source's name on this page, for vela.more.

tileSize.doc: px; 0 is 200 on TV, 132 on a phone, else 168.

tileGrid.tv: A focus grid; the first tile takes focus as the page opens.

timeline.doc: A virtualized square photo grid with calendar headings and cursor paging.

pending.doc: Whether a page is being read ({src.x.$pending}).

source.doc: The list source name for vela.more.

timeline.tv: Moves by D-pad through square photo tiles.

trackTable.doc: A tracklist: number (a play control on hover, a live meter on the track playing), cover, title with the explicit mark and artist, album, the heart, duration and the row menu. Double-click or Enter plays from a track (a tap on touch, select on TV); right-click or long-press opens the menu.

album.doc: Show the album column (wide windows only, never on TV).

covers.doc: Show each track's cover (a playlist, Liked Songs, Top Tracks).

discs.doc: Group a multi-disc album under disc headings.

entryIds.doc: Playlist entry ids, parallel to tracks (a vela.playlist source's entryIds): Remove from this playlist, and drag reorder.

header.doc: Draw the column header (never on a phone).

limit.doc: At most this many rows (Popular's 5, or 10 after See more); 0 is all.

playlist.doc: The playlist id when the tracks are its entries.

position.doc: Number by position instead of track number.

reorder.doc: Drag rows to reorder (a playlist the viewer owns; web pointer only). Needs playlist and entryIds.

sourceId.doc: Where the tracks are listed (Now Playing's "Playing from"): its id.

tracks.doc: The tracks: a list source ({items, more}) or a list of item: records.

trackTable.tv: Each row is one focus target (select plays, a long select opens the menu); nothing inside a row takes focus. Rows draw with the page; a list longer than 200 rows draws its first 200 and the rest as the viewer nears the end.

visualizer.doc: The music visualizer (implementation: the visualizer lead): Now Playing's background or full screen with the scene picker.

sceneId.doc: The scene; the viewer's choice when absent.

visualizer.tv: Drawn only where env.canVisualize; a generic fallback elsewhere.

wash.doc: The wash behind a page's top: the artwork's colour (and the artwork, blurred, on the web) fading into the page.

accent.doc: The colour; the skin's accent when empty.

image.doc: The artwork drawn blurred under it (web).

experiences.description:

tokens.description: `$name` in any style value. Colours become CSS properties the theme sheet sets.

traits.description: How the foundation frames the document's pages: home fades under a floating bar; home, libraries and Live TV pan sideways.

Sent only to a client with X-Vela-Screen-Renderer, for a surface published for the viewer.

vela.duplicatePreference.doc: Choose the preferred release of a recording, optionally hiding the others.

vela.like.doc: Like or unlike (follow, save) a title. The answer patches the item record and refreshes favorites lists on the page.

source.doc: A list source on this page.

vela.more.doc: Read the next page of a list source (appended to its items).

context.doc: What to play through: the name of a list source on this page, or an `item:` container (album, artist, playlist, show).

item.doc: The item to start at (`item:` key or id); the first of the context when absent.

vela.play.doc: Play an item, a container, or a list on this page from an item.

vela.playNext.doc: Queue to play after the current item.

library.doc: The library the playlist is for.

text.doc: The file text (with name and format).

url.doc: A link to a playlist on an advertised source.

vela.playlistImport.doc: Start a playlist import; its progress is polled into the `import:current` record.

exclude.doc: Comma-separated matched indices to leave out.

vela.playlistImportSave.doc: Save the finished import as a playlist; navigates to it.

vela.setVisualizerScene.doc: The viewer's visualizer scene on this device (per profile, not synced).

vela.startRadio.doc: Play the seed, then what the server continues it with.

VelaActions.description: The vela.* local actions (press `plugin` with `name: "vela.<name>"`), answered by the client; built-in documents only.

limit.doc: Children per page (1 to 1000; 100 when absent).

role.doc: One child level (album, track, concert); every child when absent.

vela.children.doc: A title's children in the server's order, paged: ListValue.

library.doc: Where the server keeps no liked lists or Favorites playlist (Jellyfin, Plex): the library whose favourite filter lists them.

vela.favorites.doc: The viewer's likes of one role, newest first, paged: ListValue.

day.doc: Days from today (0 when absent; the guide reaches a week ahead).

vela.guide.doc: One day of the Live TV guide: GuideValue, channels as `channel:` records.

vela.import.doc: The playlist import in progress: a reference to `import:current` (ImportRecord).

limit.doc: Titles per page (1 to 100; the server's default when absent).

sort.doc: A sort the library offers (title, added, year, …).

tab.doc: One of the library's tabs (its album view, say).

view.doc: A named view: `albums`, the library's searchable album view (with q; unsupported where the library has none).

vela.libraryInfo.doc: What a library holds and what the server offers for it: LibraryInfoValue.

translate.doc: A language to translate into, when the server offers it.

vela.musicHome.doc: The music app's Home: MusicHomeValue (quick tiles, Vela's own recent shelves, the library's rows).

vela.nowPlaying.doc: What plays now: a reference to `nowPlaying:current` (NowPlayingRecord), pushed about once a second while a page reads it.

vela.photoAlbums.doc: Photo albums from the library’s album level, paged: ListValue.

id.doc: With a person id, list their photos instead of the subject facet.

vela.photoPeople.doc: The library’s subjects or one subject’s photos, paged: ListValue.

vela.photoTimeline.doc: Photos by taken date, newest first, paged: ListValue.

audio.doc: Only entries that play as audio (items, entryIds and total together).

vela.playlist.doc: One playlist and its entries: PlaylistValue.

vela.playlists.doc: The viewer's playlists as `item:` records of kind playlist: ListValue.

vela.queue.doc: The audio queue: a reference to the `queue:current` record (QueueRecord).

vela.recent.doc: What the viewer last played from: RecentValue.

vela.recording.doc: Every release of the title's recording: RecordingValue.

placement.doc: Home's rows, a title's related rows, or a library's recommended rows.

tab.doc: placement library: a recommended tab's own rows.

kind.doc: A result kind the server offers (searchKinds).

library.doc: Search within one library (its media class when the server cannot scope).

q.doc: The query; empty answers no items.

vela.search.doc: Search results, paged: SearchValue (the audio app's search).

id.doc: A title id (an `item:` key is accepted too).

vela.title.doc: One title: TitleValue. Its `item:` record carries the card; the source adds what only a detail read knows.

vela.visualizer.doc: The viewer's visualizer setting on this device: a reference to `setting:visualizer` (VisualizerSetting).

platforms.description: Renderer 20: a style overlay per platform, applied last (after small, wide, breakpoints, tv and fold).

props.description: The block's props (rich-blocks.ts), as Templates; a single hole passes its raw value.

states.description: The first state whose conditions hold replaces `style` on the same element (transitions run).

style.description: Overrides by viewport: `small` under 640 px, `wide` from 1200 px, `tv` on a TV (renderer 19).

WidgetNode.description:
Widgets: `install`, `observe`, `liveTile`; `searchInput` (params placeholder, label, placeholderColor; its node style sets the
text's colour and font) within 3 levels of home or the shell; `sentinel` (params.on: `row` | `home` | `library`) asks for
the next page; `select` (params options: library.genres | library.sorts | library.kinds, action, arg with {value},
none: a leading empty option's label, label) is the platform select styled by its node.

a11y.description: The press button's accessibility state and role.

active.description: While pressed (pointer down), over the hover style: e.g. { scale: '0.97' } as a compiled control's press scale.

disabled.description: A pressable box: disabled while these hold, drawn with `disabledStyle`.

escape.description: Escape clears this flag and moves focus to `returnFocus` (an element id).

exit.description: A motion preset played as the node leaves.

fold.description: Renderer 20: on a foldable held partly open (env.fold), after `tv`.

group.description: A group's hover or focus (`group: true` on an ancestor) applies `groupHover` here; its keyboard focus `groupFocus`.

hover.description: Pointer hover and keyboard focus overlays (the renderer tracks both).

id.description: A box's element id (`detail-scroll-{env.entry}`: the route's scroll the navigation restores).

motion.description: A motion preset by name (`motion` table), its delay staggered by the item index.

needs.description: Renderer 19, screens: lazy sources read when this node is about to draw.

onChange.description: Renderer 19: play a motion preset when the filled value changes (a score pops).
